Enter version codes

Paste one student report per line. A bare version code works, and so does a full row copied from a spreadsheet. Lines without a version code (such as a header row) are skipped.

Full row, to verify a report: Name, Attempt, Version code, Phase 1, Phase 2, Phase 3, Check code
Commas or tabs both work. Example: Juan Dela Cruz, 2, Y59R-WK9S, 40, 36, 24, 5L7A9HDY
Quick lookup: Y59R-WK9S or Juan Dela Cruz Y59R-WK9S
Your list is kept in this browser only.

#StudentAtt.VersionBusiness (owner)ScoreCheck codeFlags

Every well-formed code produces an exam, so the check code is what confirms a report is genuine. A shared code means two or more rows carry the same exam version. Each student gets a fresh random code, so this usually points to a copied report.
